{"title":"Verify AgentRuntime migration and Claude Code adapter implementation","body":"Verified the AgentRuntime abstraction and Claude Code adapter refactor:

1. `AgentRuntime` registry and contracts (`core/runtime.ts`):
   - Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `SessionHandle`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, `RuntimeConfig`, `RuntimeEvent`.
   - Created `createRuntimeRegistry` function supporting default runtime lookup and runtime mapping.

2. Session layer (`core/session/session.ts` and `core/session/session-manager.ts`):
   - `Session` accepts `runtimeId`, supports `attachRuntime(runtime, handle)`, and manages event processing through the runtime interface while emitting `runtime_session_observed` alongside backwards-compatible `cc_session_id_observed`.
   - `SessionManager` threads `registry` through session creation, uses `lookupByCcSid` callback provided by the adapter, and delegates snapshot reconstruction to `runtime.reconstructSnapshot`.

3. Sessions handler (`core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`):
   - Removed direct dependency on Claude Code adapter models; resolves model validation via registry (`isAllowedModel`) with fallback, and resumes sessions via `runtime.resolveResumeRef`.

4. Claude Code adapter (`adapters/claude-code/index.ts`):
   - Implements full `AgentRuntime` and `AppRuntime` contracts, including lifecycle (`spawn`, `terminate`), event streams, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, and CC session ID mapping.

5. Verifications:
   - Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) passes cleanly with no errors.
   - Test suite passes cleanly (61/61 tests passing across 8 test suites)."}

submission.body:
Verified the AgentRuntime abstraction and Claude Code adapter refactor:

1. `AgentRuntime` registry and contracts (`core/runtime.ts`):
   - Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `SessionHandle`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, `RuntimeConfig`, `RuntimeEvent`.
   - Created `createRuntimeRegistry` function supporting default runtime lookup and runtime mapping.

2. Session layer (`core/session/session.ts` and `core/session/session-manager.ts`):
   - `Session` accepts `runtimeId`, supports `attachRuntime(runtime, handle)`, and manages event processing through the runtime interface while emitting `runtime_session_observed` alongside backwards-compatible `cc_session_id_observed`.
   - `SessionManager` threads `registry` through session creation, uses `lookupByCcSid` callback provided by the adapter, and delegates snapshot reconstruction to `runtime.reconstructSnapshot`.

3. Sessions handler (`core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`):
   - Removed direct dependency on Claude Code adapter models; resolves model validation via registry (`isAllowedModel`) with fallback, and resumes sessions via `runtime.resolveResumeRef`.

4. Claude Code adapter (`adapters/claude-code/index.ts`):
   - Implements full `AgentRuntime` and `AppRuntime` contracts, including lifecycle (`spawn`, `terminate`), event streams, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, and CC session ID mapping.

5. Verifications:
   - Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) passes cleanly with no errors.
   - Test suite passes cleanly (61/61 tests passing across 8 test suites).

Verified the AgentRuntime abstraction and Claude Code adapter refactor:

1. `AgentRuntime` registry and contracts (`core/runtime.ts`):
   - Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `SessionHandle`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, `RuntimeConfig`, `RuntimeEvent`.

   - `Session` accepts `runtimeId`, supports `attachRuntime(runtime, handle)`, and manages event processing through the runtime interface while emitting `runtime_session_observed` alongside backwards-compatible `cc_session_id_observed`.
   - `SessionManager` threads `registry` through session creation, uses `lookupByCcSid` callback provided by the adapter, and delegates snapshot reconstruction to `runtime.reconstructSnapshot`.

3. Sessions handler (`core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`):
   - Removed direct dependency on Claude Code adapter models; resolves model validation via registry (`isAllowedModel`) with fallback, and resumes sessions via `runtime.resolveResumeRef`.

4. Claude Code adapter (`adapters/claude-code/index.ts`):
   - Implements full `AgentRuntime` and `AppRuntime` contracts, including lifecycle (`spawn`, `terminate`), event streams, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, and CC session ID mapping.

5. Verifications:
   - Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) passes cleanly with no errors.
   - Test suite passes cleanly (61/61 tests passing across 8 test suites).
